correctness.rationale: Exact two-moment closure and Green area formula reduce feasible angles to [pi/4,pi/2]. For any admissible perturbation f, the sine-convolution p satisfies p=p' =0 at both ends and Q(f)=integral(p²-p'²)<0 by Dirichlet Poincare; the length-pi equality case is killed by p'(0)=0. Explicit dual obstacle H-lambda cosx vanishes in central interval and is 1-cos(|x|-alpha)>0 in saturated outer intervals, making first variation nonpositive and strict quadratic remainder negative. Differentiated optimized F(m) changes sign at the sole algebraic root. Independently recomputed derivative factorization and exact maximum numerical expression. The analytic proof, not samples, covers measurable profiles.

originality.rationale: Kominers 2026 introduced geometry and one smooth cosine profile. Two inspected published Resultary findings optimize a fixed-m cosine slice and then a two-parameter cosine class with areas 0.7871835 and 0.7888438. Their feasible sets are strict subfamilies. The present unrestricted measurable moment class has discontinuous bang-bang optimum, a strict concavity and KKT-type dual obstacle classification, and area 0.7945785; neither smaller-family theorem implies it. Best-of-knowledge with full-text access caveat to Kominers original.
